seoTitle: The Summer I Turned Pretty Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take The Summer I Turned Pretty test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Belly, Conrad, Jeremiah, Steven, Taylor, Laurel, Susannah or Cam — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the hopeless romantic, the brooding one, or the golden retriever? Answer 12 everyday questions about love, family and summers that change everything, and find out which character from The Summer I Turned Pretty you are.

characters.name: Belly Conklin
characters.title: The Hopeless Romantic
characters.summary: Romantic, all-in and full of feeling. When you love something, whether it's a person or a place, you love it completely.
description: Like Belly, you live for the moments that matter. For her, summer at Cousins Beach is the best part of every year.
You fall hard. Belly has loved Conrad since she was ten, and she spends the show caught between him and his brother, Jeremiah.
You find yourself in the end. Belly calls off her wedding to Jeremiah, goes to Paris on her own, and ends up with Conrad after all.
characters.flaw: You change your mind so often that the people around you get whiplash.
characters.signature: A beach house, a necklace with an infinity charm and a heart that's always torn.
characters.clashReason: they'd go back and forth for years and never decide

characters.name: Conrad Fisher
characters.title: The Brooding One
characters.summary: Quiet, guarded and deeply loyal. You feel everything, you just don't say it out loud.
description: Like Conrad, you keep your feelings to yourself. He's Susannah's eldest son, aloof on the outside and carrying a lot underneath.
You carry other people's weight. Conrad struggles with panic attacks, and he made his mum a promise to look after his younger brother.
You love quietly, but completely. Conrad is torn between his feelings for Belly and his loyalty to Jeremiah, and he and Belly end up together in the end.
characters.flaw: You hold everything in until it's almost too late to say it.
characters.signature: A long stare at the ocean and a promise you'll keep no matter what.
characters.clashReason: they'd shut you out right when you need them to talk

characters.name: Jeremiah Fisher
characters.title: The Golden Retriever
characters.summary: Warm, playful and the life of every party. You make people feel good, and you hate letting anyone down.
description: Like Jeremiah, you're easy to love. He's Conrad's younger brother: playful, carefree and always there for Belly.
You wear your heart on your sleeve. Jeremiah is emotionally open, and he proposes to Belly while they're still in college.
But you can be jealous. Jeremiah has spent his whole life feeling second to his big brother, Conrad.
characters.flaw: You'd rather say what people want to hear than risk upsetting them.
characters.signature: A big grin, a pool party and a group chat you're always first to reply in.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you what you want to hear instead of the truth

characters.name: Steven Conklin
characters.title: The Confident Big Brother
characters.summary: Smart, ambitious and never short of a joke. You work hard, tease harder and always land on your feet.
description: Like Steven, you're a high achiever. Belly's older brother was his class valedictorian and headed off to Princeton.
You love a bit of teasing. Steven never misses a chance to wind up his little sister, but he's always got her back.
You go after what you want. Steven ends up starting his own business, and building a relationship with Belly's best friend, Taylor.
characters.flaw: You hide what you're really feeling behind a joke.
characters.signature: A Princeton hoodie, a big plan and a joke at your sister's expense.
characters.clashReason: they'd tease you about everything, all the time

characters.name: Taylor Jewel
characters.title: The Main Character
characters.summary: Bold, dramatic and impossible to ignore. You've got main-character energy, and you're not sorry about it.
description: Like Taylor, you make every room yours. She's Belly's best friend, and she never does anything halfway.
You say what you think. Taylor is loud, honest and always ready with an opinion, whether anyone asked or not.
You go for what you want. Taylor's kiss with Steven put a real strain on her friendship with Belly, but she and Steven end up together.
characters.flaw: You make things about you, even when they really aren't.
characters.signature: A perfect outfit, a dramatic entrance and an opinion on everyone's love life.
characters.clashReason: they'd make your big moment all about them

characters.name: Laurel Park
characters.title: The Steady One
characters.summary: Practical, honest and quietly strong. You keep it together when everything else is falling apart.
description: Like Laurel, you're the sensible one. She's Belly and Steven's mum, and an author.
You keep your feelings private. Since her divorce, Laurel has struggled to write, but she rarely lets anyone see how much she's carrying.
You're there when it counts. Laurel has been Susannah's best friend for years, and she stands by her through everything.
characters.flaw: You're so busy holding it together that you forget to let anyone hold you.
characters.signature: A notebook, a strong cup of tea and a sensible plan.
characters.clashReason: they'd answer your big feelings with a sensible plan

characters.name: Susannah Fisher
characters.title: The Warm Heart
characters.summary: Warm, generous and full of life. You make everyone feel like family, and every day feel like summer.
description: Like Susannah, you make people feel at home. She's Conrad and Jeremiah's mum, and she treats Belly like a daughter.
You make the most of every moment. Susannah fills the beach house with love, and she's the reason everyone keeps coming back every summer.
You're braver than you let on. Susannah faces her cancer diagnosis with grace, and her love for her family shapes everything that follows.
characters.flaw: You hide your own pain so you don't worry the people you love.
characters.signature: A house full of people, music playing and a big hug for whoever walks in.
characters.clashReason: they'd keep smiling and never tell you something was wrong

characters.name: Cam Cameron
characters.title: The Sweet Nerd
characters.summary: Kind, curious and happily yourself. You'd rather talk about something fascinating than be cool.
description: Like Cam, you march to your own beat. He's a Cousins Beach local whose mum works at the country club.
You love learning. Cam is passionate about marine biology, and he's not shy about sharing what he knows.
You're honest and kind, even when it hurts. Cam dates Belly in season one, until she realises her heart is somewhere else.
characters.flaw: You're so nice that people forget to take you seriously.
characters.signature: A book about whales, a kind smile and a fact for every occasion.
characters.clashReason: they'd be so kind about it that you couldn't even be angry

questions.text: It's the first day of the summer holidays. You...

options.text: Head straight back to the place you love most. Same as every year
Throw a party. Summer has officially started
Get a summer job. Time to make some money
Start a new project, like learning a language or tracking the local wildlife

questions.text: Someone you like suddenly starts acting cold and distant. You...

options.text: Overanalyse every word they've ever said to you
Text them and demand to know what's going on
Give them space. People come round in their own time
Understand completely. You do the same thing when you're struggling

questions.text: You're hosting friends for the weekend. You...

options.text: Fill the house with flowers, music and far too much food
Plan every outfit and every photo op
Make sure there are clean towels, then slip away to get some work done
Make sure everyone's having fun, all the time

questions.text: Two people you care about both have feelings for you. You...

options.text: Change your mind every week, and hate yourself for it
Step back, so you don't come between them
Pick the hotter one. Obviously
Be honest with both of them, straight away

questions.text: Your friends are planning a big night out. You...

options.text: Lead the charge. You'll be the last one standing
Bring the energy, and tease everyone all night
Go, but slip away early without telling anyone
Suggest stargazing on the beach instead

questions.text: A friend asks for your brutally honest advice. You...

options.text: Be straight with them, then help them work out some practical next steps
Say exactly what you think, whether they're ready or not
Tell them gently, with a hug, and remind them they'll be okay
Soften it until it's basically what they wanted to hear

questions.text: Someone you love gets some really bad news about their health. You...

options.text: Quietly take care of everything, and never talk about how you're feeling
Make every single day with them feel special
Drop everything and be there, whatever it costs you
Make them laugh. Somebody has to

questions.text: You're offered a great opportunity, but it's far away from everyone you love. You...

options.text: Take it. This is your shot
Write a list of pros and cons, and go with what it says
Go. You need to find out who you are on your own
Say yes, and promise to call every day. Life's too short not to

questions.text: Your brother or sister gets something you really wanted. You...

options.text: Act fine, but feel it for years
Laugh it off, then quietly work twice as hard
Make sure everyone knows it should have been you
Be genuinely happy for them

questions.text: You made a promise, and keeping it is starting to hurt you. You...

options.text: Keep it. You gave your word
Break it, if your heart tells you to
Talk it through, and find a sensible middle ground
Explain kindly why you can't keep it any more

questions.text: You're about to marry one brother, and you realise you're still in love with the other. You...

options.text: Call off the wedding and go after the one you really love
Go through with it. You can't bear the thought of hurting anyone
Sit down, take a breath and think it through before you do anything
Tell them both the truth today, before it gets any worse

questions.text: It's your last summer at the beach house you grew up in. You...

options.text: Throw one last perfect party, so everyone remembers it forever
Fight to save the house. You can't just let it go
Take a million photos, and post every single one
Sit on the beach alone at sunrise, and say goodbye in your own way
